zh-CN.title: 成长奖励进入展映模式
items: 奖励以 3:1 核心画幅自动轮播，不再逐项阻塞揭晓流程
底部奖励改为可横滑、可点击回放的完整奖励轨道
聊天背景、气泡和头像框支持在升级现场直接换上

en.title: Growth rewards enter showcase mode
items: Rewards now autoplay in a 3:1 showcase without blocking the reveal flow
The complete reward rail supports horizontal scrolling and instant replay
Chat backgrounds, bubbles, and avatar frames can now be equipped during the celebration
